title: Simulization - world scale, history spanning RTS
author: Emu_Fast
selftext:
Imagine your favorite RTS titles but they just never end. Inspired by decades of great titles, and years managing a simulation community, I've got a vision for a game that spans human history and has evolving mechanics as you progress through the eras.

I'm blown away by Opus 5.5, and giving it enough skills/mcp access. I tried doing similar just a few months ago and was hitting a dead end. I'm still wasting tokens in some areas, but it's getting closer.

I actually started it as just a world generator. I was looking for an older procedural planet generator utility I used to use and couldn't find it, so I made one (might share pictures of that later). Then I modelled the spread of civilization from a single origin, and modelling branching conditions and cultural evolution. The result was a decent enough spread across the continents, but it needed better mechanics per era.

That's when I thought, I should gamify this a bit. So I did, and I toyed with a few modes before settling on an RTS. I'm hopeful that the end state will sort of exist as a mix of games, inspired by the big names but being entirely new. Each era will focus on different systems but will carry the earlier eras with it.

More to come - just wanted to share what I've got!
